name: Volcano
uniques: Rare feature
Rough terrain
Has an elevation of [2] for visibility calculations
Always Fertility [-2] for Map Generation

civilopediaText.text: A smouldering peak. Volcanoes are rare: only a handful of Mountain tiles on a map become one.
The ash makes the surrounding land fertile: every land tile next to a Volcano yields +1 Food.
